sonnet.problem: This card re-asks a fact already asked. Card 4's right answer was that God will dwell in Jerusalem, and Jerusalem is named again in cards 5 and 6. The baker can pick 'Jerusalem' just because it keeps coming up.
sonnet.rule: An easy follow-up asks something new. It never re-asks the same fact.

sonnet.problem: The blank is the number of men (ten, three or seven). Nothing in the earlier cards lets a thoughtful baker reason their way to it. It works like the 'oil, myrrh or perfume' example, which is pure luck.
sonnet.rule: If the only way to get it right is luck, give the story card more context or ask a different question.

sonnet.problem: The joke 'when God says it twice, friend, you'd better sit DOWN' uses the repeated wording in God's speech as its hook. It also sets Papa Dorin's own habit of repeating himself next to God's. That makes the way Scripture is written the joke.
sonnet.rule: Holy things, like the ark, and the way Scripture is written are never the joke.
